summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) furnishing a TR-1 major-holdings notification dated 11 November 2026. The Capital Group Companies, Inc. (Los Angeles) reported crossing above the 18% threshold on 9 November 2026, reaching 18.007061% of voting rights (387,897,511 shares) versus a prior 17.975584%, split between 13.360845% ordinary shares (ISIN GB0002875804) and 4.646216% depositary receipts (US1104481072), with no financial instruments. No board recommendation, advisor, price or transaction mechanics disclosed; this is a routine passive stake-disclosure, not a control event. Watch for further incremental accumulation or activist intent and any shift from passive ownership.
